description: Force reconciliation of one instance so its recorded state is re-derived from what the host actually reports. Use when an instance's status looks wrong or stale — for example, running in our records but gone on the host. Requires expected_version (the `version` get_instance returns) and an idempotency key. Corrects bookkeeping only: it does not start, stop, or move the workload, and it changes nothing about what the instance is billing. Call it with confirm:false (the default) first: that previews the instance and its current state, and changes nothing. Then call again with confirm:true to act.

confirm.description: false (the default) previews and changes nothing; true acts

name: reconcile_instance
title: Reconcile instance
